newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine Jan-Sept foreign investment $375.6 mln.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine Jan-Sept foreign investment $375.6 mln.

text.p: Foreign investment in Ukraine's economy for the first nine months of this year totalled $375.6 million, the Statistics Ministry said on Monday.
The ministry did not provide figures for the first nine months of 1995.
Total investment from independence in 1991 to date has totalled $1.223 billion, it said. Economists blame the low investment rate on bureaucracy and unclear laws.
The United States was Ukraine's largest foreign investor, followed by Germany, Russia, Netherlands, Britain and Cyprus. --Yuri Kulikov, Kiev Newsroom +380 44 229 2264
